ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The lower part of the figure is a tetrasubstituted alkene, with each carbon at the two ends of the double bond connected to two methyl groups, identifiable as (CH3)2C=C(CH3)2. The upper part of the figure is an ozone form, with the left-end oxygen carrying a negative charge, the middle oxygen carrying a positive charge, and the right-end oxygen and the middle oxygen represented with a double bond, namely O(-)-O(+)=O. The curved arrows in the figure indicate that electrons redistribute from the alkene and ozone system, forming new C-O bonds and moving O-O π electrons. Reasoning: After pushing according to the arrows, the C=C π bond of the alkene participates in bond formation, and the two alkene carbons respectively form C-O σ bonds with the terminal oxygens of ozone; the O=O π electrons inside ozone correspondingly transfer to an O-O single-bond connection. The original C-C σ bond between the two alkene carbons is retained, therefore forming a five-membered cyclic trioxide structure containing C-O-O-O-C. The two ring carbons each still carry two methyl groups, so the product SMILES is CC1(C)OOOC1(C)C.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the bottom double bond as (CH3)2C=C(CH3)2 and the top reagent as ozone with O(-)-O(+)=O. Then follow each arrow to update bonds: convert the C=C pi bond into a new C-O sigma bond, shift the O=O electrons, and create the second C-O sigma bond from the terminal ozone oxygen to the other alkene carbon. Keep the original C-C bond between the two alkene carbons, so the product is a five-membered cyclic trioxide with both ring carbons bearing two methyl groups. Encode that cyclic structure as the SMILES CC1(C)OOOC1(C)C.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中下方是一个四取代烯烃，双键两端碳各连有两个甲基，可识别为 (CH3)2C=C(CH3)2。图中上方是臭氧形式，左端氧带负号，中间氧带正号，右端氧与中间氧以双键表示，即 O(-)-O(+)=O。图中弯箭头表示电子从烯烃和臭氧体系重新分布，形成新的 C-O 键并移动 O-O π 电子。推理：按箭头推动后，烯烃的 C=C π 键参与成键，两个烯烃碳分别与臭氧的端氧形成 C-O σ 键；臭氧内部的 O=O π 电子相应转移为 O-O 单键连接。原来两个烯烃碳之间的 C-C σ 键保留，因此生成一个含 C-O-O-O-C 的五元环状三氧化物结构。两个环碳各仍带两个甲基，所以产物 SMILES 为 CC1(C)OOOC1(C)C。
